Full methodology ↗
What is being simulated?

Trip index = 100 × max(0, 1 + elasticity × fare change). Revenue index = trip index × (1 + fare change). Fare changes use the notebook’s −10% to +15% range. An index of 100 is the selected context’s baseline; distance and trip mix are held fixed.

What can the historical data tell us?

The master table contains 2024 high-volume FHV zone–hour summaries. Trip volume averages annual totals across weekday categories; it is not trips per hour. Higher demand can itself raise prices, so historical price–volume associations do not identify the effect of changing fares.

Missing data, outliers & provenance

Missing coefficients are not filled in. Four unusually high price rows remain visible with a warning. Zone-hour gaps show an empty state. No weather, driver supply, or event effects are fabricated.
